prompt: Which interstate war has had the highest estimated number of combat deaths since World War II?
answer: The **Korean War (1950–1953)** had the highest estimated death toll among interstate wars since World War II. Estimates commonly range from approximately **2.6 million to 4.1 million combat-related deaths**, although figures vary depending on whether civilian war deaths are included.
